text: Rank my top 5 most annoying habits. No wrong answers.
What's a hill I'd die on that you actually agree with but won't admit?
What's a compliment I give myself that you secretly think is cope?
If I were a Wikipedia article, what would the 'Controversies' section say?
What's the most red-flag thing about me that you've chosen to live with?
What's a take I have that's wrong, but I deliver with so much confidence you let it slide?
Roast my last outfit. Be specific. Be cruel.
What's a small lie I tell myself that you spotted years ago?
Pick one trait of mine and exaggerate it until it's a war crime.
If our relationship got a Netflix documentary, what's the title?
Cast us as a reality show. Show name, premise, and who's the villain edit.
What's the trailer voiceover for our last argument?
If we had a tag-team wrestling name, what is it?
Write the confessional booth quote I'd give about you this week.
We're on Love Island. What's the producer-engineered drama?
Our biopic gets made. Who plays us? It can be insulting.
What's a scene from our relationship that would absolutely make the recap montage?
If a doc crew followed us for a week, what's the most embarrassing B-roll?
What's my Roman Empire? You know the one.
What's a take I have that's so wrong it's basically a personality trait?
Three words that would summon me from across a room.
Pitch my villain origin story. What's the inciting incident?
What's my conspiracy theory? The one I bring up when drunk.
If I had a TED Talk, what's the title and how is the audience reacting?
What's a brand or store that's so 'me' it's almost a slur?
What's a song I claim to hate but you've caught me humming?
If my search history leaked, what would the headline be?
If I were a sandwich, what's on it and why is it slightly cursed?
We have to commit one (1) federal crime together. What is it?
We're a two-person cult. What do we worship and what's the dress code?
I die tragically. What's the most chaotic thing in my eulogy?
We're stuck in an elevator for 72 hours with one snack. What snack and what's the body count?
We have to swap one personality trait for a week. Which trade goes the worst?
We get cursed by a witch but it's actually mildly inconvenient. What's the curse?
We're trapped in a sitcom. What's the bit they overuse on us?
We open a restaurant together. It fails immediately. Why?
What's something I do that you find weirdly hot?
When was the last time I made you feel safe? Be specific.
What's a small thing I did this week that you're still thinking about?
If you had to bottle a feeling I give you, what's on the label?
What's a memory of us you'd save if you could only keep five?
Finish the sentence: I knew I was in trouble when you ___
What's something about me you'd want our future kid (or dog, or houseplant) to inherit?
Describe me to a stranger in three sentences. Be honest, not nice.
What's a moment with me you'd time-travel back to right now?
Rate this week from 1–10. Defend your answer.
Rank our last 5 dates. The worst one is now law.
On a scale of 1 to red flag, how concerning is my last Spotify Wrapped?
Rank my friends by who you'd actually pick to hang out with solo.
Rate my texting style this week. Brutal scoring encouraged.
Rank the rooms of our home by how much they reflect my personality.
Rate my last attempt to be romantic. Bonus points for receipts.
Rank the takeout we've ordered this month. Defend the bottom one.
On a scale of 1 to 'concerning', how am I as a driver?
Pick a city we've never been to. We're going. What do we do on day one?
We retire tomorrow. What's the first dumb thing we buy?
Plan our funeral. Mine first. Make it humiliating.
We win the lottery. Walk me through the next 24 hours.
Describe our life 10 years from now in five very specific objects on a kitchen counter.
We start a podcast tomorrow. What's the title, the premise, and the inevitable scandal?
